terms.definition: The gravitational force per unit mass at a point, g = F/m.
The force between two point masses is proportional to the product of the masses and inversely proportional to the square of their separation.
terms.examiner: F = −GMm/r²; the minus sign shows attraction.

terms.definition: The work done per unit mass in bringing a small mass from infinity to that point.
terms.examiner: Always negative; zero at infinity. V_g = −GM/r.

terms.definition: The minimum speed an object needs at the surface to escape the gravitational field.
